text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Multiple 5xx and high p95 latency in AWS us-east-1 impacting Hosted API + some Dedicated pools. Observed at ~1934567000.

Aisha (oncall): i'm on it. marking P1. pinging Ben/Carla/Evan.

Ben (sre): seeing a big spike in 502/504 from ELB and upstream 401s from auth provider. traces show surge of retries causing connection queueing.

Carla (eng-platform): Dedicated pool healthchecks failing in us-east-1b, some woker init timeouts. Starting regional mitigation runbook.

Aisha (oncall): quick plan: 1) reduce us-east-1 traffic weight 2) tighten retry policy at edge 3) open AWS case 4) provide status to customers. Applying weight now.

Carla (eng-platform): executing:
```
redwoodctl routing modify --region us-east-1 --weight 25 --reason "ELB errors"
```

AuthProvider-AlertBot: Noted: increased 401 rate in us-east-1 for token validation service.

Evan (support): preparing template for Dedicated customers with pinned pools. need list of affected customer ids.

Ben (sre): changed retry policy to avoid cascade. config pushed to edge pool:
```
retry.max = 2
retry.backoff_ms = 150
circuit.breaker.enabled = true
```

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-03-14-UST1. Owner: Aisha (oncall).

AWS Support Bot: Case #CASE-67890 created. Investigating ELB target failures in us-east-1.

Carla (eng-platform): started controlled rehome for two critical Dedicated customers: cust-211 and cust-924 to eu-west-1 warm spares. will update when complete.

Ben (sre): note: auth-provider team responded 999	"we are seeing elevated token store latencies in us-east-1, affecting validation endpoints". they're escalating.

Aisha (oncall): status page note drafted: "Degraded performance and increased errors in US East (us-east-1) affecting Hosted API and some Dedicated pools. Traffic rerouted and mitigations in progress. Next update in 15 minutes."

Evan (support): sending targeted tickets to affected Dedicated customers offering rehome or wait for regional recovery.

Carla (eng-platform): rehome command run: 
```
redwoodctl dedicated migrate --customer cust-211 --target eu-west-1 --auto-accept
redwoodctl dedicated migrate --customer cust-924 --target eu-west-1 --auto-accept
```
rehomes in progress (~4min each).

Ben (sre): after routing + retry changes hosted traffic p95 dropped from ~3.6s to ~1.0s. remaining errors concentrated on pinned Dedicated instances in us-east-1.

AuthProvider-AlertBot: Auth provider status page updated: Partial outage in us-east-1, token validation latency elevated.

Aisha (oncall): AWS case update: they see high ELB 502s for targets in a subset of AZs; root cause under investigation. recommended avoiding scaling in affected AZs.

Carla (eng-platform): applying AZ-level drain for problematic AZs:
```
redwoodctl routing az-set --region us-east-1 --az us-east-1a --weight 10
redwoodctl routing az-set --region us-east-1 --az us-east-1b --weight 40
redwoodctl routing az-set --region us-east-1 --az us-east-1c --weight 50
```

Ben (sre): acceptance tests for rehomed Dedicated instances passing for cust-211 and cust-924. marking them migrated.

Evan (support): notified customers: both opted for migration, minor IP change noted. no functional regressions reported.

Aisha (oncall): current mitigation summary: traffic shifted away from us-east-1, retries reduced, AZ drains in place, two Dedicated customers rehomed to eu-west-1, AWS + auth provider engaged.

incident-bot: Next update scheduled in 15m.

Ben (sre): action items: collect traces for postmortem, verify no residual auth 401s, follow AWS case until clear.

Carla (eng-platform): filing backlog ticket for longer-term safeguards: per-region circuit-breakers, automated warm-spare failover, better AZ-aware routing.

Aisha (oncall): handing off follow-up to Ben at end of shift. Ben will coordinate postmortem and customer RCA.

Ben (sre): acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring and update when AWS confirms remediation.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-14-UST1 status -> monitoring.

Aisha (oncall): closing live page but keeping incident open until AWS confirms. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
